notes.title: West Ride 40% Discount on Release!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings Travellers[/b],

We're thrilled to announce that West Ride, our exciting new game, is making its debut on Steam! To celebrate this momentous occasion, 
we are offering an exclusive discount of [b]40%[/b] for a limited time.

Starting today and lasting until [b]July 23[/b], you can immerse yourself in the world of West Ride at an incredible 40% off its original price.

Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to embark on an epic adventure, and unravel the mysteries that await.

Thank you for your continuous support. We look forward to sharing this exciting journey with you.

See you at station!
